title: Stock Intel — NSE Kenya Intelligence Platform

Deployed free: FastAPI on Render with self-ping keep-alive, React on Vercel.

Key Features:
• 60-point scoring across Profitability, Dividend, Growth, Value, Asset Safety, Debt Safety
• Live NSE prices — all 31+ stocks in one bulk scrape
• Gold signal engine: H4/H1/M30 confluence, EMA/MACD/RSI/ATR, 3:1 RR enforced
• Full backtest engine with equity curve, win rate, profit factor, max drawdown
• Portfolio tracker: unrealized P&L, annualized return, dividend tracking
• Self-healing backend — never shows a blank screen

Impact: Institutional-grade analysis, free, for any Kenyan investor with a browser. The data is real. The edge is measurable.

Business Objective: An accessible system for tracking contributions and loans.

My Approach: A user-friendly platform with member registration, contribution tracking, loan management, secure transactions, financial reporting and member notifications.

title: Student Multivendor System
description:
Problem: Students need one place for campus commerce.

Business Objective: A marketplace connecting student vendors and buyers.

My Approach: A multi-vendor platform with vendor registration, product listings, order management and tracking, multi-user roles and secure payments.

title: Karate Management System
description:
Problem: Martial arts schools need efficient ways to manage trainees and track progression.

Business Objective: A digital platform for dojo management and student progress.

My Approach: A secure web platform with trainee profiles, belt progression tracking, trainer authentication and training schedule management.

title: Fitness Management System
description:
Problem: Gyms need digital tools for member management and access control.

Business Objective: A complete system for gym operations and member services.

My Approach: A secure platform with a member registration portal, authentication and automated password recovery, on a user-friendly interface.
